definitions: To exhaust one's energy or resources by overwork or by living life too intensely.
To work or do too much, from early morning until late at night, causing one to become tired or ill.
examples: She's been burning the candle at both ends trying to finish her degree while working full-time.
If you keep burning the candle at both ends, you'll eventually crash.
He learned the hard way not to burn the candle at both ends during exam season.
lemma: to burn the candle at both ends
source: to burn the candle at both ends
